Seven comments

Roaring Mary

This is the third reel in the Joe Cooley set which starts with the Humours of Tulla followed by the Skylark. In many sessions if you start with the Humours of Tulla it’s taken for granted that the other two will follow.

↳ Posted by Bannerman on June 14th, 2002.

↳ Posted by slainte on July 11th, 2006.

Called Foxie Mary on Cape Breton fiddler Joe MacLean’s album.

↳ Posted by GaryAMartin on March 5th, 2009.

Roaring Mary, X:3

Very similar to the first setting here, but with a three subtle differences:
1. substitutes c for e in the first half of bars 3, 7, and 15;
2. replaces the F roll at the end of bar 3 with a passage parallel to those in bars 7 and 15;
3. replaces the 4th bar with a passage parallel to bars 8 and 16.

↳ Posted by GaryAMartin on February 3rd, 2016.

Roaring Mary, X:3

Changes #2 and 3 also accord with setting #2.

↳ Posted by GaryAMartin on February 3rd, 2016.

Roaring Mary, X:4

Slightly different take on the A section, as heard on several recordings.

↳ Posted by Ian Varley on January 22nd, 2017.
